title: Internal Hom from a pseudo-coherent or perfect complex to a supported complex
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. If L is in D^+_{QCoh}(O_X) and K is pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], then RSheafHom(K,L) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] is in D_{QCoh}(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and is locally bounded below. If L is in D_{QCoh}(O_X) and K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then RSheafHom(K,L) is in D_{QCoh}(O_X). In either case, if L is supported on a closed subset T, then RSheafHom(K,L) is supported on T because derived internal Hom commutes with restriction to opens.
